You paid seventy-nine ninety-nine for Grand Theft Auto Six. So who actually got your money?
The store keeps about twenty-four dollars.
Sony gets about twelve, just because it is a PlayStation disc.
The disc, the box, and the truck cost about four.
And Take-Two, the owner of Rockstar, gets about forty.
But those forty dollars still have to pay back a game that may have cost up to two billion dollars.
Here is the twist. Buy it digitally, and Take-Two gets about fifty-six.
